item.title: Version 0.8.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Wallpaper transitions: Ripple, Bokeh, Crystal, Blinds and Stardust when a display switches wallpapers, and a Loom Line, Frame Unfold or Daybreak opening at launch
  • All displays switched by one action start their transition together
  • Wallpaper Automation sheet with Playlist, Daily Schedule on a 24-hour dial, and Library Shuffle; skipped wallpapers show why
  • A manual pause now holds through property edits, rotation, replugging and relaunch
  • Pro: a Workshop item lives in the library once — the Steam copy takes over a local copy, and a manual download asks before replacing it

Improvements

  • Wallpapers on an external drive keep their setup while the drive is ejected and come back when it mounts; automation skips them meanwhile
  • Rotation countdowns freeze while you are away and restart when you pick, apply a scheme or apply a Workshop item by hand
  • Web wallpapers pause on serious thermal pressure, like video
  • Pro: scenes spanned across displays relayout when a display joins or leaves, and settings reach displays that are disconnected
  • Pro: many more scenes render like Windows — authored vertex shaders, camera intros, scene text layout, clear color, per-submesh model textures and the effect swap command

Bug Fixes

  • Picking a new wallpaper for a paused display no longer resumes the old one if the new one fails to load
  • Switching a spanned display to video or web takes it out of the span
  • Schedule dial edges can no longer collapse or wrap a slot, and every slot is reachable with VoiceOver
  • Pro: hover and click hits follow the scene camera, and scripts on particles and text target the right layer
  • Pro: scripts that set only loop or rate on a video now play it
  • Pro: album covers in media scenes are no longer too dark
  • Pro: scripts that create and destroy layers repeatedly no longer fail the scene
  • Pro: malformed shaders, textures and script values no longer crash or hang the app
  • Backups no longer carry per-display pause state

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
